text:
ashley: kicking off the tenant_id type migration. planning a controlled switchover with a manual holdpoint at the DB migration step. holdpoint scheduled for 21:10 UTC. tagging SRE and oncall to watch. main concern: long backfill holding row locks on writes.

ben: ack — i'll be on call 20:50-22:30. can monitor tx wait times and take the rollback path if locks spike.

maria: staging canary started. running the migration job with a small shard first. will report locks and latency.

sam: quick question — do we have an automatic resume policy if the holdpoint goes past our window? would prefer non-blocking resume to keep prod healthy.

ashley: yes — proposed non-blocking resume behaviour: if holdpoint > 15m then resume only canary traffic (10%) with chunked backfill and extended slow path, do not rollout to 100% automatically. manual approval required for full resume. escape hatch = immediate abort + revert to pinned service image.

ashley: escape hatch commands for quick reference:
```
# create/verify holdpoint (ops)
deploy-bot holdpoint create --id migrate-tenantid-2026-03 --owner ashley --timeout 15m

# revert service to pinned image if rollback required
kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:v1.4.2 --namespace prod

# DB: cancel migration worker(s) if blocking (example)
SELECT pg_cancel_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%tenant_id_backfill%';
```

maria: adding chunking suggestion to run backfill in windows: LIMIT 2500 with a 150ms sleep between batches to limit lock hold. also will add a TTL for tombstone rows to minimize long-term storage growth.

b en: small nit: pin the DB client version in the release notes and on the deploy manifest so rollback is a single kube update. I'll run the pinned-image revert if we need to abort.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: holdpoint created by ashley at 1718625500 for migrate-tenantid-2026-03. status=active.

ashley: updated release notes and pinned migration version: migrate-tenantid-2026-03 (sha: a1b2c3). also added a short checklist in the release: 
- Notify SRE and oncall (done)
- Pin API DB client to 1.4.2 (done)
- Create holdpoint at migration step (done)
- Configure staggered backfill and chunk size (in progress)
- Create dashboard panels for lock time and worker lag (TODO)

maria: canary metrics look good so far. no p99 lock spikes during a 10-minute window. starting staggered backfill on shard-1.

sam: recommending an automated guard: if p95 lock time > 200ms for 3 consecutive minutes, pause backfill and notify channel.

ben: agreed — i'll wire the alert rule and stand by to run rollback commands if threshold trips.

ashley: starting canary -> 10% rollout now. monitoring closely.

deploy-bot: :rocket: deploy started: service/api canary 10% -> success. metrics snapshot: requests p50 +12ms, db lock p95 unchanged.

maria: no lock increases observed. continuing staggered patching.

ben: if we see any write errors or deadlocks, call rollback channel immediately. otherwise we'll proceed to staged resume after 30m observation.

ashley: thanks everyone. posting post-mortem template to the thread after cutover. if anything happens during the holdpoint window, escalate to the migration-rollback channel.

sam: final note — after full resume, run a low-priority compact job to clean temporary rows to reduce future lock surface.

ashley: closing this thread for now, will update with final status.
